This Grixis Control deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's strategy and gaining advantage through card advantage and removal spells. It contains cards like Invoke Despair and Go for the Throat to deal with threats, as well as Fable of the Mirror-Breaker for additional card draw. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bloodtithe Harvester provide powerful late-game threats while Corpse Appraiser helps search for key creatures. With a mix of removal, card advantage, and strong finishers, this deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent in a 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bringing them back onto the battlefield for a game-winning combo. It uses cards like Corpse Appraiser and Reckoner Bankbuster to get creatures into the graveyard, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and The Cruelty of Gix allow for easy reanimation. Atraxa, Grand Unifier helps to stabilize and protect the combo pieces, while removal spells like Go for the Throat and Abrade help to control the board. The mana base includes various dual lands to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors.
